test_title: SSC GD Constable Previous Year Paper (Held on: 2nd December 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: A shopkeeper offers 28% discount on the marked price of an article and still gains 20%. If the marked price is ₹900, then the cost price (in ₹ ) of the article will be:
solution:
Given:

Profit % = 20%

Discount at Marked Price = 28%

Marked Price = Rs 900

Formula:

MP × (100 - D%) = CP × (100 + G%) = SP

Where-

MP = Marked Price, CP = Cost Price,
